_README: First cited joint-rule table (doc 16 §2 Source C/doc 13 rules engine). Hinge count by door weight, per GTV's own application chart. Data, not code — the solver's hinge-count selection function reads this.

source.scope: cup hinges Ø26 and Ø35 (wide-angle special models per footnote), door width ≤450mm, height ≤2500mm, hinge-to-edge ≥90mm

placement_principles_from_source: distance between hinges as large as possible
count depends on door height, width AND weight
mounting tests required before mass production
engine_notes: Door weight = area × material density (materials catalog already plans density_kg_per_m3, IMOS_FEATURE_MAP). Cross-check bands against Blum TA catalogue and factory practice before verified:true.
